title: TemplateCreatorsResponse
description: Distinct egress-template creators, with a truncation signal for the bounded scan

truncated.description: True when the bounded creator scan hit its page cap and the list may be incomplete; false when the full creator set was returned.

id.description: Raw createdBy user ID (the value to filter the list endpoint by)

name.description: Resolved display name, or null when unresolved

email.description: Resolved email, or null when unresolved
